title: Equivalent Exchange Once More
description: You see a familiar face in Sumeru City...

mainQuestExcel.title: Equivalent Exchange Once More
mainQuestExcel.description: You see a familiar face in Sumeru City...

dialogs.text: Hmm... How should I carve this again...
Hi!
Ugh, who's there? Stop bothering me already, I'm...
Eh!? Traveler!? What brings you here to Sumeru?
Come on, Rudolf can't have sent you to beat me up, right? I did nothing but send Lily a little gift way back when!
I'm just stopping by...
So you're still traveling. Just can't stop, can you?
But, you know... I didn't expect to see you here in Sumeru...
My original orders were to relocate from Mondstadt to Snezhnaya.
But another order came and I was sent to Sumeru City to assist Mr. Vsevolod. Moreover, I was told that I was being transferred to Lord Pulcinella's command.
Pulcinella?
Yes... Well, no. I shall stop here, or Mr. Vsevolod would criticize my insensitivity to affairs of confidentiality.
*sigh* The names of our Lord Harbingers are no secret. I can never understand why he's so antsy about it.
So, what are you doing in Sumeru?
Oh, Mr. Vsevolod and I are mainly responsible for logistical support and coordination. In short, we go shopping a lot.
It doesn't sound like a big deal, but it's certainly nicer than idling away in the Mondstadt Cathedral.
Hehe, my current job also comes with lots of free time, and no one's keeping an eye on me...
So I picked back my childhood wood carving hobby back up. And guess what, Sumeru happens to be rich in wood. Perfect for practice!
And you know what? My wood carvings are actually popular among kids. They have been bothering me about it, so I promised to carve one for them each.
Aren't you with the Fatui?
Yes, so what? I mean... Who says a Fatuus can't make toys for kids?
Besides, I'm just the supply guy. As for all those fancy great deals, I'll just leave them to the Lords.
All in all, that's the situation here. I wasn't able to return to Snezhnaya, but I kinda like Sumeru. There's food, entertainment, and a pretty nice environment here.
After work, I just grab some food and get myself a nice sunny spot for some wood carving.
However... Haha, everyone gives me those skeptical looks, just like the one you gave me when we first talked.
But there's nothing I can do. I'm a Fatuus after all.
I still don't really trust you even now.
Okay... Basically, I'm quite happy with my life now, and I even managed to keep some savings.
If these days continue, I might just settle down here in Sumeru...
Ahem, well, that's enough of that. Now that you're also here, Traveler, let's continue our "equivalent exchange," if you're in.
But I'm also out of stories, so your payment will be in real currency this time around.
Well, that works better for me.
Alright, let me make the commission clear.
I ordered some wood from Hamawi lately, but it hasn't been delivered yet.
I can't go talk to him during working hours, or Mr. Vsevolod will scold me for sure.
Traveler, would you please do me a favor and ask Hamawi about my wood delivery?
Just get my payment ready.
Rest assured. I won't let you down.
Anyway, I'll leave this to you, Traveler.
You sure you're not up to anything...?
Come on, when did I play dirty tricks in our trades before? Don't worry, I can't be bothered, anyway... What's wrong with a peaceful, simple life?
Am I taking commissions from the Fatui?
Of course not, you'll just be doing commissions for Viktor.
Who says I trust you now? Stop cottoning up to me!
You're not trying to pump the kids for information... Are you?
Hey! I'd never do that! What's with your horrible stereotype of us Fatui?
Another Harbinger?
That's right, come back to Mondstadt with me!
Ha, ha, ha, alright. Want a pair of shackles to lead me away while you're at it?
Okay, enough joking around. I've got things to deal with.
V—Viktor?
I didn't expect myself to ever be able to pick up wood carving again...
What awful luck...
About Viktor's wood delivery...
Are you talking about the wood that the Fatuus ordered?
*sigh* I knew dealing with the Fatui wouldn't end well.
We were attacked by monsters while transporting that wood. All of us made it back alive, but our cart didn't. We were forced to leave the wood by the roadside.
I dare not go over there, nor can I find someone to get rid of those monsters so soon...
We aren't Fatui...
Aren't you a Fatuus? Then why are you helping him?
Anyway, I can only leave my cart there for now and see if I can hire someone to deal with the situation.
If you are anxious to get the wood, I'll mark the approximate location of the cart on the map for you, then you can go take a look for yourself.
*sigh* Nothing good ever comes of things that the Fatui are involved in...

I didn't expect myself to ever be able to pick up wood carving again...
*sigh* Nothing good ever comes of things that the Fatui are involved in...
About Viktor's wood...
This wood... You've chased away all the monsters? You're stronger than you look...
Thank you. I'll head over with a few others later and bring the wood back.
*sigh* Nothing good ever comes of things that the Fatui are involved in...
How did it go? Has my wood arrived?
You tell Viktor what happened...
Monsters again? Sheesh, is it just me, or does it feel like every cart in the world is being attacked by monsters...
Ugh, never mind... it's all good as long my wood gets here.
Oh, right. Here's the payment I promised you. Count it up if you like.
Uh, by the way... Um, is Lily doing well?
I didn't say goodbye to her before I left. I hope she isn't angry...
She's doing really well.
Alright. *cough* Come on, don't look at me like that. I was just a little concerned!
Anyway, make sure you count your remuneration up. I prepared the exact amount, Traveler.
Go back and visit her yourself.
Mr. Vsevolod will definitely kick my rear end if I do that. Forget it.
I don't quite dare to send a letter directly either.
Receiving a letter from a Fatuus sounds like a bad thing, after all. Hahaha...

questNarration.text: (What a wonderful place. Ah, if only I could stay here forever...)
